name: Improved Order Independent Transparency for Opaque Kernels
aliases: Improved Order Independent Transparency (OIT) for Opaque Kernels
definition: An OIT variant that improves rendering of opaque kernels by incorporating the contribution of the closest sample into the transparency accumulation, reducing transparency artifacts compared to standard OIT while maintaining performance close to geometry instancing.
summary: This method reduces transparency artifacts in opaque kernels by explicitly handling the closest sample's contribution while using standard OIT accumulation for the rest, balancing quality and speed.
